features.title: Report a dead link with file:line
features.intent: Running against a folder with one dead link exits non-zero and prints the link with file:line.
features.serves: REQ-AC1: dead links must be reported precisely and fail the run
acceptance: Running the CLI on a folder with one dead link exits non-zero and prints that link's file and line.

features.title: Retry an unreachable host once before reporting
features.intent: Unreachable-host timeouts are retried once before being reported.
features.serves: REQ-AC3: transient timeouts must not become false positives
acceptance: A link whose host times out is retried exactly once before being reported as dead.
